All Regional Provident Fund Commissioner-Incharge
Regional/Sub- Regional Offices

Subject: Instructions in regard to making 100% payment through NEFT/RTGS
where beneficiaries bank accounts is in NEFT/RTGS enabled bank-
reg.

Sir,

May kindly refer to this Office Circular letter No. circulars bearing No.
Bkg./Fraud/0S/18210 dated 22.11.2011, Bkg/Fraud/05/1S614 dated 24.11.2011,
Bkg/Fraud/05/39906 dated 20.12.2011, Bkg./Fraud/05/22901 dated 20.01.2012,
Bkg/Fraud/05/45354 dated 27.01.2012 and Bkg/Fraud/05/75956 dated 01.02.2012
(posted at Sr. No. 405, 408, 460, 508, 519 and 530 respectively under Office
Orders/Circulars year 201 1-12 on Official website of EPFO).

2. From various references received from Field Offices, it 1s noticed that the
payment are being made by some Office to the members through cheques under the limit
prescribed vide circular letter dated 24.11.2011 in those cases also where the bank
account of beneficiary is maintained with NEFT enabled bank.

3, To avoid any doubt on the above situation, the following clarifications are
issued:

i, Wherever the beneficiary ask for payment in a Bank which do not have
IFSC Code and payment cannot be made thrugh NEFT/RTGS, the
payment may be made through cheques for the amount upto which the
limit is prescribed under Office circular letter No. Bkg./Fraud/05/156 14
dated 24.11.2011.

ii. | Where the beneficiaries ask for payment in a Bank which has IFSC Code
and also enabled for NEFT/RTGS, the payment should be made through
NEFT/RTGS ONLY irrespective of the quantum of amount even if
the amount is within the limit prescribed under circular letter dated
24.11.2011.

Y faithfully,

(Abhay Ranjan)
Regional P F Commissioner-[
